EmailTemplate.subject: Happy National Volunteer Month and Thank You for Your Service!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
April is National Volunteer Month – Thank you <Blood Program Leader Name>!
Did you know that 90% of the American Red Cross workforce is comprised of volunteers? Volunteers are the heart of the Red Cross, and Blood Program Leaders like YOU are the lifeline to patients in need. Without your help, we could not fulfill our lifesaving mission. You make it possible.
Thank you for stepping up to help collect and donate lifesaving blood. By opening your doors, you provide a place for donors in your community to roll up their sleeve to give. <Insert if BPL is hosting a drive April 1-30> This National Volunteer Month, we are especially grateful to our Blood Program Leaders for committing to host drives that help the critical need we anticipate in summer months.
Hear from the Dandridge family about their journey of perseverance with sickle cell disease, and their appreciation for all donors that give blood.
On behalf of those we serve, thank you once again for your tremendous efforts. I look forward to continuing to work with you, helping save lives of those in need.
Sincerely,
<Account Manager Name>
PS. Want to pay it forward? Thank your blood program volunteers using the attached email template.
